flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_creation/core/helpers/{NoticeValidationHelper (existing FP/PRA notice counts as duplicate), NoticeRecordHelper (PS-DBB without refund), PermanentSuspensionHelper.createRefundRecord (refund in manual route only), SuspensionBaseHelper.getPsRefundCodes}; ocmsadminprivateapi notification_sms_email/helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper (generic sender) + prod properties. ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no related code.
note: Sheet status: 'Requirement given - Gen flow'. No code sends an SMS/email saying 'notice cancelled and refund will be processed' after PS-DBB. In the code, the 'paid duplicate' scenario means the existing notice is already paid (FP/PRA), so the NEW notice is suspended as PS-DBB; the paid notice is neither suspended nor refunded by DBB. A refund record is only created in the manual suspension route for codes in PS_REFUND_CODES (DB data, cannot verify from repo). A generic SMS/email sender exists but is not triggered and is switched off in the prod properties. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. Ask URA which notice is refunded in the paid-duplicate scenario, then build the refund trigger and its notification

steps.step: The paid duplicate notice is permanently suspended by OCMS
steps.detail: When the existing notice is already paid (PS with crs reason FP/PRA), the NEW notice gets PS-DBB. The paid notice itself is not suspended by DBB. A manual PS on a paid notice is only allowed for codes in PS_REFUND_CODES (SuspensionBaseHelper.java:121-124); whether DBB is in that list cannot verify from repo (ocms_standard_code data).

steps.step: OCMS checks whether an SMS/email notification was already sent on the same day
steps.detail: Same as OCMS21.2 step 2: no code links PS-DBB to same-day ocms_sms_notification_records.

steps.step: A refund is processed for that paid notice
steps.detail: Refund record creation (ocms_refund_notice) exists in the manual suspension route PermanentSuspensionHelper.createRefundRecord, only for PS codes in PS_REFUND_CODES (DB data, cannot verify whether DBB is included). The automatic PS-DBB path at notice creation (NoticeRecordHelper.java:497-503) never calls refund.

steps.step: The SMS/email text states that the notice is cancelled and a refund will be processed
steps.detail: No template or cancellation + refund text exists in the six repos (grep cancel/refund only finds payment reports and the refund record). Template in the DB cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The SMS/email is delivered to the vehicle owner
steps.detail: Same as OCMS21.2 step 5: the generic sender exists but is not triggered by the DBB suspension; prod: sms.enable=false (application-prod.properties:87), email.enableSmtp=false (80), cron.notification.enabled=false (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236); real server values cannot verify from repo.
